mapper.select: SELECT plandetails.*, item.`name` as item_name, item.check_method, item.check_tool, item.judge_type, item.standard_max, item.standard_min FROM tpm_maintenance_plan_details as plandetails INNER JOIN tpm_maintenance_item as item ON plandetails.item_id = item.id WHERE plandetails.plan_id = #{planId}
